title: 第五章异地蓬莱
slug: 洪荒无量道全本免费-洪荒无量道最新章节列表
content_zh:
风洛探出神念，搜寻此地的核心，不一会儿便从地底深处寻到禁制，元神相合，不久有关此地的信息便了解透彻，即便风洛得到过造化青莲这样的至宝时才会心神震动，但是知道了这处地方，也不由一阵惊异：“居然是蓬莱岛，这处即便在洪荒之中也是极为神秘之地，号称散修圣地的仙岛。”要说海外各岛屿最后有名的便是那蓬莱、瀛洲、方丈三座仙岛了，这三岛确实是一处妙地，盘古开天，洪荒中几乎所有的山脉都是那盘古身躯所化，惟独这蓬莱、瀛洲、方丈三岛却是从那混沌中直接落入东海的混沌碎片。《山海经》曾有记载：海上有三座仙山，蓬莱、瀛洲、方丈，山上是仙境，有长生不老药。而蓬莱海域常出现的海市蜃楼奇观，更激发了人们寻仙求药的热情，秦皇、汉武等古代帝王纷纷到蓬莱开始了寻仙活动。
蓬莱岛方圆二十万里，山峰林立，条条山脉蜿蜒伸向天际，宛若巨龙。丛林灌木，苍天劲松不计其数，又有各种天材地宝，可谓是绝佳的仙家胜境。而这样的地方，自然少不了一些奇珍异兽，虽然尚未有灵智，但是生于洪荒，又在岛中，资质自然是不用说，若得开启灵智，再加上修炼功法，凭着这里浓厚的先天灵气，修为自是一日千里。
这海外三岛在封神之前是不显于世的，据说鸿钧道祖即使成圣也无法算出三岛的位置，合道之后才知晓。不管是不是真，这蓬莱仙岛绝对不弱于昆仑等地。“事情倒是越来越复杂了，也不知道是好是坏。但愿不要惹到我，即使你修为通天，我也要让你知道后悔。”风洛心中一惊，眼中更是寒光闪烁。穿越重生、得至宝造化青莲又身处蓬莱这种异地，就算脑袋不灵光，也会发现处处透着诡异。穿越重生如果还能认为是命好，但是身为异数又得至宝，还有蓬莱这处顶级道场，异数可是不容于天地、不得天道眷顾的存在，怎么还如此有大气运傍身，分明是有强大的存在操控着这一切。风洛已经不是原来的小白了，对修行之道也有了相应的认识，没有无缘无故的爱，凭什么自己能得到这么多，若说自己为异数，怎么都说不过去。
“算了，没有实力，做什么都无用，当自己修道有成，拥有强大的实力，一切皆会水落石出。”甩掉心中的各种念头，风洛知道想再多也无用，也不再理会，因为他知道自己现在不会有危险，这就够了。“呵呵，倒是好心态，也不枉我救你一命，谁让你当时就站在那处被混沌之力冲刷之地。救了你也不知是福是祸，洪荒的情况，也越来越复杂了！”在一处莫名的空间中，也不知是在洪荒还是混沌中，传来幽幽叹息声，其中又充满威严。“洪荒的未来已经充满了变数，要想完成超脱，只能靠你们自己了啊！”话音落下，此处就又恢复平静，好像从来没有声音传出过一样，如以往般只有永恒的孤寂。可惜，风洛对此一无所知，也没有能力去探寻到什么。
而与此同时，在距离盘古开天过去九个纪元之后，永恒如一、万古空寂的混沌深处再次发生了震荡，有光明照耀万古，几乎要将混沌世界点亮，同时黑暗降临，光暗交融世界生；也有雷霆轰鸣有神出世，神将创世；还有命运之力轮转，以无上伟力于混沌中扎下世界种子。在这一刻，几乎同一时间，混沌动荡，不再是那种毫无生气的状态。而这些距离洪荒太过遥远几乎不可到达，因此洪荒依旧，不可能了解到这一情况。对风洛来说更是如此，这些距离他太过遥远与神秘了。

content_en:
Feng Luo used his spiritual thoughts to search for the core of this place. After a while, he found the restriction from the depths of the ground and the unity of the soul. Soon he understood the information about this place thoroughly. Even though Feng Luo was only shocked when he got a treasure like the Green Lotus of Creation, but when he learned about this place, he couldn't help but be surprised: "It's actually Penglai Island. This place is extremely rare even in the prehistoric times. The mysterious land, the Immortal Island known as the holy land of casual cultivators. "The last most famous of the overseas islands are the three Immortal Islands of Penglai, Yingzhou, and Fangzhang. These three islands are indeed a wonderful place. Pangu opened the sky. Almost all the mountains in the prehistoric era were transformed from the body of Pangu. Only the three islands of Penglai, Yingzhou, and Fangzhang were fragments of chaos that fell directly into the East China Sea from the chaos. "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" once recorded: There are three fairy mountains on the sea, Penglai, Yingzhou, and Fangzhang. The mountains are fairyland and have the elixir of immortality. The mirages that often appeared in the Penglai sea area inspired people's enthusiasm for seeking immortality and medicine. Ancient emperors such as Emperor Qin and Emperor Wu of Han Dynasty came to Penglai one after another to start searching for immortals.
Penglai Island has a radius of 200,000 miles, with numerous peaks and mountains stretching to the sky like giant dragons. There are countless jungles, shrubs, and tall pines in the sky, and there are all kinds of natural materials and treasures. It can be said to be an excellent fairyland. In a place like this, there are naturally some rare and exotic beasts. Although they do not yet have spiritual intelligence, they were born in the wilderness and on the island. It goes without saying that they have aptitudes. If they can open their spiritual intelligence and practice martial arts, relying on the strong innate spiritual energy here, their cultivation will be rapid.
These three overseas islands were not visible to the world before becoming a god. It is said that even if Taoist Hongjun became a saint, he would not be able to calculate the location of the three islands. He only knew them after he became a Taoist. Regardless of whether it is true or not, this Penglai Island is definitely not weaker than Kunlun and other places. "Things are getting more and more complicated. I don't know if it's good or bad. I hope you don't offend me. Even if your cultivation reaches the sky, I will let you know that you regret it." Feng Luo was startled, and his eyes flashed with cold light. After traveling through time and being reborn, obtaining the treasure Qinglian, and being in a foreign place like Penglai, even if you don't have a clear head, you will still find something strange everywhere. If you can still think that you have a good destiny after time travel and rebirth, but as an anomaly, you have obtained a treasure, and there is a top dojo in Penglai. Anomaly is an existence that cannot be tolerated by heaven and earth, and cannot be favored by heaven. How can you still have such great luck around you? There is clearly a powerful being controlling all of this. Feng Luo is no longer the original Xiaobai, and has a corresponding understanding of the way of cultivation. There is no love without reason. How can he get so much? If he is said to be an anomaly, it cannot be justified.
"Forget it, without strength, anything you do is useless. When you become successful in cultivation and have strong strength, everything will come to light." Shaking away all the thoughts in his mind, Feng Luo knew that it was useless no matter how much he thought about it, and he ignored it because he knew that he would not be in danger now, and that was enough. "Haha, you have a good attitude, and I saved your life in vain. Who made you stand in that place washed away by the power of chaos? I don't know if it was a blessing or a curse to save you, the situation in the primitive world has become more and more complicated!" In an inexplicable space, whether it was in the primitive world or chaos, a faint sigh was heard, and it was full of majesty. "The prehistoric future is already full of variables. If you want to achieve transcendence, you can only rely on yourselves!" After the words fell, the place returned to calm, as if no sound had ever been heard, and there was only eternal loneliness as before. Unfortunately, Feng Luo knew nothing about it and had no ability to find out anything.
At the same time, nine epochs have passed since Pangu opened the sky, the eternal and empty depths of chaos once again shook. There was light shining for eternity, almost lighting up the chaotic world. At the same time, darkness fell, and light and darkness merged to create the world; there were also thunders, gods were born, and gods would create the world; and the power of fate rotated, planting the seeds of the world in the chaos with supreme power.. At this moment, almost at the same time, chaos and turmoil were no longer in that lifeless state. These are too far away from the ancient world and are almost inaccessible, so the ancient world remains the same and it is impossible to understand this situation. This is especially true for Feng Luo. These distances are too far away and mysterious for him.
